decisions: Retain all six formerly held source units using independently checked literal readings, with blank gloss where no lexical translation is supplied. Expand the explicitly shared okoe base transparently.
Retain quoted identifiable morphology cabā and kū with source-explicit functional metadata; do not classify them as ordinary unqualified lexical words.
Recover pa’eṉ and paheṉ as separate unglossed p171 attestations. Do not harmonize ruled n to plain n or infer variant/borrowing edges.
Retain p171 affixal hōṉ as a distinct morphology attestation from p169 lexical even; source analyses differ.
Retain p172 song as one whole translated stanza, preserving source spelling spendid in the translation and typed fine-mark uncertainty for geṭer/geter. No invented word alignment.
bound_morphology_policy: Explicitly quoted identifiable source morphemes are in scope. Abstract variables and foreign controls require individually recorded exclusion decisions.
next_gate: Merge independently reconciled expression inventories into reproducible full-source proposal, check source profile coverage and metadata, then fresh raw-to-output audit and focused tests.
deferred: Full data build and full suite
Global compiled identity and graph verification
